author: Scikit-Plots Learn
description: A reusable provenance check for any technical topic.
empty_message: No one has applied Check a reference before reusing a claim to this topic yet.
instruction:
1. Open the original source rather than a secondary summary.
2. Locate the exact section supporting the claim.
3. Record the source version and a stable locator.
4. Separate what the source states from your interpretation.
5. Mark missing or conflicting evidence explicitly.
6. Re-run the check when the source version or claim changes; replace stale notes instead of appending contradictory copies.
title: Check a reference before reusing a claim
